patterns: APPSC asks definitional one-liners: NI = NNP at factor cost, per capita income = average income, real GDP = output at base-year prices, GNP deflator ratio.
Recurring traps: MP vs FC differ by indirect taxes and subsidies (not direct taxes); GDP vs GNP differ by net factor income from abroad.
A-R item on transfer earnings excluded from NI; GNP deflator rise lowers purchasing power; APSES SDP definition asked word for word.
Other PSCs favour formula-statement items (NNP = GNP - depreciation, NI = NNP_MP - (IT - subsidies)) and 'best measure of growth = per capita real income'.
App matches these shapes well; it adds 2022-23 series, double deflation and PPP agency items beyond PYQ depth.
